title: Prostate Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for prostate cancer. Full pathway: initial workup -> disease state -> (localized risk group -> local modality -> pathology / intensification sub-step; biochemical recurrence -> restage -> salvage vs metastatic; mCSPC volume -> fitness -> intensification -> progression; nmCRPC PSADT -> ARPI -> progression; mCRPC biomarker -> line of therapy -> on-progression second / third line) -> surveillance. Progression arms from nmCRPC and mCSPC converge into the shared mCRPC line-of-therapy subtree, mirroring real sequencing. Each treatment leaf routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference; modalities without a dose protocol (active surveillance, radiation, surgery, apalutamide/darolutamide, pembrolizumab MSI-H, radium-223, sipuleucel-T) are shown as checklist guidance with NO dose. Workup / risk-stratification / staging / surveillance content is standard oncology, not proprietary guideline text; structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate Cancer, no proprietary content reproduced. Invents no dose/regimen. DRAFT - not clinically activated; the physician decides and the existing dose engine computes patient doses.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Prostate Cancer. Regimen options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers; the dose engine computes patient doses.

a.text: Confirm castrate testosterone (< 50 ng/dL, ideally < 20 ng/dL) before labelling any disease castration-resistant; continue ADT backbone through all subsequent lines.

b.text: PSMA-PET has higher sensitivity than conventional bone scan + CT for staging unfavorable-intermediate and higher risk disease and for restaging biochemical recurrence; it may reclassify apparently non-metastatic disease as metastatic.

c.text: Germline and somatic homologous-recombination-repair (HRR: BRCA1/2, ATM, PALB2...) and MMR/MSI testing is recommended in metastatic and high-risk disease and directs PARP-inhibitor and immunotherapy eligibility.

d.text: Avoid sequential ARPI-to-ARPI switching (e.g. abiraterone then enzalutamide) at progression; cross-resistance limits benefit - switch mechanism of action where possible.

e.text: Maintain bone health on long-term ADT: baseline and periodic DEXA, calcium / vitamin D, and a bone-modifying agent (denosumab or zoledronic acid) for osteoporosis or for skeletal-related-event prevention in mCRPC bone metastases.

nodes.name: Localized risk group

bullets.label: Favorable intermediate

bullets.label: Unfavorable intermediate

nodes.name: Active surveillance

nodes.name: Low-risk modality
nodes.title: Low risk: definitive modality

nodes.name: Low risk RP

nodes.name: Low risk RT

nodes.name: Favorable modality

nodes.name: Favorable post-RP surveillance

nodes.name: Favorable RT

bullets: EBRT (hypofractionated or SBRT) or brachytherapy; ADT generally omitted

nodes.name: Unfavorable modality
nodes.title: Unfavorable intermediate: modality

nodes.name: Unfavorable post-RP surveillance

nodes.name: High-risk modality

nodes.name: High-risk RT + ADT

nodes.title: mCSPC low-volume: ADT + ARPI + radiation to primary

nodes.name: mCSPC progression
nodes.title: mCSPC: on progression
nodes.description: Rising PSA / radiographic progression despite castrate testosterone signals castration resistance and moves to the mCRPC pathway; a controlled response continues current therapy.
bullets: Confirm castrate testosterone before labelling castration-resistant
Progression: enter the mCRPC biomarker + line-of-therapy pathway

nodes.name: mCSPC maintain
nodes.title: mCSPC responding: continue and monitor
nodes.description: Continue the current mCSPC backbone with PSA / imaging monitoring while disease is controlled.
bullets: Continue ADT + intensification agent

nodes.name: nmCRPC PSADT
nodes.title: nmCRPC: PSA doubling-time
nodes.description: Confirm castrate testosterone and M0 status (PSMA-PET may reclassify to metastatic). A short PSA doubling-time drives treatment intensification.
bullets: Confirm castrate testosterone (< 50 ng/dL) and M0 status

nodes.name: nmCRPC ARPI
nodes.title: nmCRPC, short PSADT: continue ADT + ARPI

bullets: Continue ADT and add apalutamide, darolutamide, or enzalutamide

nodes.name: nmCRPC monitor
nodes.title: nmCRPC, long PSADT: continue ADT and monitor

nodes.name: nmCRPC progression
nodes.title: nmCRPC: on progression to metastatic

nodes.name: nmCRPC continue
nodes.title: nmCRPC controlled: continue ADT + ARPI
nodes.description: Maintain ADT + ARPI with monitoring while disease remains non-metastatic and controlled.
bullets: Continue ADT + ARPI

nodes.name: mCRPC option
nodes.title: mCRPC: biomarker / burden
nodes.description: In mCRPC, select the directing feature. Obtain HRR (germline + somatic), MMR/MSI, and PSMA-PET where available.
bullets: Confirm castrate testosterone before labelling castration-resistant
